title: Daily Workout · November 9
note: Monday · 48-minute moderate, controlled session after Sunday's recovery day. Prescribed effort is conversational; actual completion and recovery have not yet been synced. Avoid breath-holding and stop for chest discomfort, dizziness, unusual palpitations, or new groin, knee, neck, or back pain. Plow pose with feet suspended is a user-reported preference, not a clinically cleared movement; skip unless specifically cleared given spine history. Its current photo depicts feet touching the floor and is reference-only, not an exact demonstration.

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.detail: 1 min · gently alternate sides within the minute
items.instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other foot beside the buttock; lean back with arm support only as comfortable. Avoid knee, groin, or back strain. Use the owner-supplied StretchCoach reference when the matching image is available.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit upright with soles together. Hold gently for 60 seconds without forcing knees down.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Keep motion gentle and controlled; avoid painful lower-back rotation.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.detail: 1 min timer · optional only if specifically cleared
items.instructions: Feet remain suspended, not resting on floor. Because this is an advanced inversion with neck and spine loading, skip unless a qualified clinician has cleared this exact variation. Never force the position or load the neck. Existing photograph shows floor contact and is reference-only, not the requested variation.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Start at an easy pace and gradually warm up.

items.name: Brisk walk
items.instructions: Comfortable conversational pace; maintain easy breathing and reduce speed for any discomfort.

items.name: Dumbbell bench press
items.instructions: Flat bench, both feet supported on the floor. Choose manageable weights, exhale while pressing, and avoid breath-holding. No assumed weight progression.

items.name: Supported dumbbell rows
items.instructions: Support your torso and maintain a neutral spine.

items.name: Bodyweight glute bridges
items.instructions: Lift only as far as comfortable without arching the lower back or straining the groin.

items.name: Dumbbell biceps curls
items.instructions: Use light-to-moderate weights, avoid swinging, and skip if elbow discomfort occurs.

items.name: Bird dogs
items.instructions: Keep hips steady and reach only as far as comfortable.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Keep the lower back comfortable and shorten the leg reach if needed.
